notes.text: melee.gg refuses automated requests, so the lists were copied from mtgtop8, which took them from Melee (event 49652). MTGGoldfish's copy of the Melee lists agrees card for card.

Placings are unresolved below 1st. Lukas Schwendinger won (all sources but Melee, and the Black Lotus prize painting). MTGGoldfish's report gives 2 Goddik, 3 Moatzu, 4 Eliott_dragon, then Gennari, Lamr, Friedrich, Rodmanbcn; that order is used here. mtgtop8 has 2 Justin Gennari, 3-4 Martinho1111 (Martin Lamr) and Moatzu. Melee's playoff standings put Gennari 1st and Schwendinger 2nd with every playoff record 0-0-0, which looks like the Swiss order with no results entered.
Organized by JK Entertainment. Names differ between Melee and mtgtop8 ("Martin Lamr" / "Martinho1111", "Fabian Weiss" / "Fabian Friedrich", "Jose Alascio" / "Moatzu"); mtgtop8's are kept.
Seeds are the standings after the last Swiss round (Round 7) on the Melee page; they match the quarterfinal pairings (1v8, 2v7, 3v6, 4v5).
Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events.
